text:
### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, essentially every case executed exactly one of three alternative activities: A19 in about 35 in 100 cases, A20 in about 30 in 100 and A21 in about 36 in 100, with the three practically never co-occurring; each was followed by A29 in roughly 97–99 in 100 of its occurrences. In the later window, each of the three appears in only about 1 in 200 cases. [OCC019, OCC020, OCC021, REL011, REL012, REL020, DIR018, DIR019, DIR020, LAG005]

- Three activities that were absent or nearly absent earlier — A26 and A27 (0 in 200 traces) and A28 (1 in 200) — now run once in every trace, around 37–38% of the way through it. Each pair of them co-occurs in 100 in 100 traces, with mixed order (roughly half the cases each way per pair), so the three run together without a fixed internal order; each is followed by one of the other two or by A29 in roughly equal thirds. [OCC024, OCC025, OCC026, POS005, POS006, POS007, REL035, REL036, REL041, DIR025, DIR026, DIR027]

- The new trio sits between A44 and A29: A44 precedes each of A26, A27 and A28 in about 99 in 100 of their joint traces, and each of the three precedes A29 in about 99 in 100. The observed distance from A44 to A29 grew from mostly 2 steps to mostly 4 steps, and A29's mean event position moved from about 0.40 to 0.44 of the trace. Earlier, A44's outgoing transitions went to A10 (about 23 in 100) and directly to A19/A20/A21 (24–27 in 100 each); now they go to A26/A27/A28 (30–33 in 100 each), with A10 down to about 2–3 in 100. [REL038, REL043, REL047, REL037, REL042, REL046, LAG009, POS008, DIR043]

- A10, previously an optional intermediate in this segment (present in about 26 in 100 cases, usually after A44 and before the A19/A20/A21 block), now appears in about 11 in 100 cases; its transitions into the old block disappeared, and it now sometimes precedes the new trio (A27 receives about 17 in 100 of A10's outgoing transitions). [OCC010, DIR010, DIR043, REL007, REL004, POS001]

- Away from this segment, branch shares moved: A38 and A39 each fell from about 55 to 45 in 100 cases while A40 and A41 each rose from about 46 to 55 in 100, with all four still frequent in both windows; after A45 the split moved from A46 (about 54 in 100 of outgoing transitions) toward A47 (about 52 in 100), with A46's overall participation down from 69 to 58 in 100 cases and A47/A48 up about 4 points; A24's outgoing traffic shifted toward A34 (42 to 59 in 100). [OCC034, OCC035, OCC036, OCC037, DIR033, DIR044, OCC042, OCC043, OCC044, DIR023]

- A few rare activities became somewhat more common — A04, A06 and A08 each roughly doubled or tripled to about 10 in 100 cases, with clearly reshaped successor profiles — but this rests on only 7–21 traces per window. [OCC004, OCC006, OCC008, DIR004, DIR006, DIR008]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that the segment between A44 and A29 was reworked: the earlier three-way alternative — exactly one of A19, A20 or A21 per case, each leading into A29 — no longer occurs (each down to about 1 in 200 traces), and in its place three previously unobserved activities, A26, A27 and A28, now run together in every case, in varying order, before A29. This is shown directly by relational evidence (the trio always co-occurs, is unordered among itself, follows A44 in about 99 in 100 joint traces and precedes A29 in about 99 in 100), by the growth of the A44→A29 distance from about two to about four steps, and by A44's outgoing traffic redirecting from A10/A19/A20/A21 to the new trio, with A10's mediating role shrinking accordingly. [REL035, REL037, REL038, REL043, LAG009, DIR043, DIR010, OCC019, OCC024, OCC010]

Limitations: the two windows are finite samples, and the evidence cannot rule out that they draw from different case populations or variant mixes rather than a modified process; moreover, zero participation only shows that A19, A20 and A21 were not observed, so their removal versus becoming unreachable in the sampled cases cannot be distinguished. [OCC019, OCC020, OCC021]

Other differences: the share shifts between the A38/A39 and A40/A41 branches, the shift from A46 toward A47/A48 after A45, the A24→A34 shift, and the increased participation of the rare activities A04, A06 and A08 are separate from this hypothesis and are not folded into it. [OCC034, OCC036, DIR044, DIR023, OCC004, OCC008]
